hotels.title: A Stylish St Leonards Stay with a Rooftop Pool
hotels.description: Set in Sydney’s leafy Lower North Shore, this polished St Leonards stay places you moments from Royal North Shore Hospital, the buzzing Crows Nest dining precinct and swift train links to the CBD. Nearby, wander through Wendy Whiteley’s Secret Garden or follow the harbourfront paths of Berry Island Reserve for sweeping water views. Inside, contemporary rooms are paired with a rooftop pool and gym overlooking the district. For dining, Crows Nest delivers everything from refined Japanese at Garfish to modern Italian plates at Annata
